name: keep-your-prompts
description: Search, reuse, save, version and deploy your prompts and agent skills from Claude Desktop.
long_description:
Keep Your Prompts is a versioned library for your prompts, system prompts and agent skills, with an inbox of prompts captured from chat. This extension connects Claude Desktop to your library with a workspace API key: search and read prompts (with their variables), create and update them as new versions, compare versions, triage your inbox, and deploy prompts to your apps. Your saved prompts also appear as MCP prompts.

It is a small local bridge to the hosted Keep Your Prompts MCP server (https://api.keepyourprompts.com/mcp). If you prefer to sign in with your account instead of an API key, add the server as a custom connector (Settings > Connectors) and skip this extension.

tools.name: search_prompts
tools.description: Hybrid keyword and semantic search over your prompts, skills and agents.

tools.name: get_prompt
tools.description: Read a prompt by id or handle, optionally a version, optionally rendered with variables.

tools.name: list_tree
tools.description: Your folders, projects and the prompts in each.

tools.name: create_prompt
tools.description: Create a prompt, skill, agent or snippet.

tools.name: update_prompt
tools.description: Change a prompt; a body change creates a new version.

tools.name: diff_versions
tools.description: Word-level diff between two versions, with variables added or removed.

tools.name: restore_version
tools.description: Make an earlier version current again.

tools.name: list_inbox
tools.description: Prompts captured from chat that are not organized yet.

tools.name: promote_capture
tools.description: Turn a captured prompt into a versioned prompt.

tools.name: improve_prompt
tools.description: Get an improved version of a prompt (does not save).

tools.name: deploy
tools.description: Deploy prompt versions to an app environment.

tools.name: discover
tools.description: Search the public library of prompts and skills by other people.

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: A workspace API key (kyp_live_...). Create one at app.keepyourprompts.com > Settings > API keys. A viewer key gives read-only tools.

api_url.title: API URL
api_url.description: Leave as is unless you run your own Keep Your Prompts server.

workspace.title: Workspace id (optional)
workspace.description: Only needed for OAuth tokens that can see several workspaces; API keys are already bound to one workspace.
